subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths that are outside the workspace root or rejected by fs-safe?
rationale: This choice crosses the Gateway file-access boundary and cannot be settled by CI because the PR changes security-relevant metadata exposure, not only UI presentation.

options.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
options.body: Remove the raw `node:fs` fallback and solve the rail UX by filtering or neutral-labeling external/directory entries without exposing outside-root metadata.

options.title: Split the visual CSS from backend semantics
options.body: Keep or rely on the current-main layout fix separately while resolving external-file behavior in the linked backend issue path.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external metadata only after explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI tests, and clear product semantics for callers.

recommendation.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw `node:fs` fallback and solve the rail UX by filtering or neutral-labeling external/directory entries without exposing outside-root metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview and browsing work makes this the closest current-main ownership signal for the file-access boundary.
